contexts: regional cancer centre, about 480 oral starts a year
oncology review every four to twelve weeks
22 percent of patients more than 100 kilometres away
reading: The service acts through three routes with different evidence: adherence (measured inconsistently, claims c1 and c2), toxicity recognised earlier (claim c3, at a possible cost in dose intensity, claim c4), and admissions averted (the basis of any saving, claim c5). Pharmacist time is the resource (claim c6). The patients at highest risk of admission are those least represented in the studies (claim c7), and the search itself is incomplete.

nodes.label: Pharmacist-led follow-up
nodes.detail: Consultation, telephone checks at days 7, 14 and 28, review before each supply.

nodes.label: Adherence
nodes.detail: Measured four ways that disagree (claims c1, c2).

nodes.label: Severe toxicity and admissions
nodes.detail: Fewer severe toxicities after checks (claim c3).

nodes.label: Pharmacist time and cost
nodes.detail: 2.6 hours per patient; budget range (claims c5, c6).

nodes.label: Older patients living alone, interpreter users, distant patients

summary: Map separates the adherence, harms and resource routes and marks the incomplete search.
